literal_meaning: সমর্থনে বা কারণে (for the sake of or on account of)
figurative_meaning_en: for the purpose of; for the sake of something, for a reason, on the occasion of
example_sentences_in_bangla: আপনার ওয়াস্তা আমি এই কাজটা করছি।
ভালোবাসার ওয়াস্তা সে সব সহ্য করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: For your sake, I'm doing this job.
For the sake of love, she endured everything.
history: Derived from Persian/Urdu 'bar wasta' meaning 'for the sake of', introduced through historical linguistic influences in Bengal.
note: This idiom reflects Persianate influences in Bengali due to Mughal era interactions.
